parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A rectangular wooden drawer that fits under the tabletop, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: Used for storing small items such as stationery or documents. It slides in and out for access.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly along rails, allowing it to open and close smoothly.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Right)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical side panel on the right side of the table, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural support and stability to the table frame.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical internal panel located near the center of the table, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the drawer and divides the under-table space.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Left)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical side panel on the left side of the table, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural support and stability to the table frame.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Front Panel
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal front-facing panel located below the tabletop, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: Covers the front area under the tabletop and provides additional rigidity.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: The flat upper surface of the table, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: Provides a stable surface for placing objects, writing, or working.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.
